prompt: Who is Patrik Vrbovský alias Rytmus?
response:
Patrik Vrbovský, known by his stage name Rytmus, is a Czech musician, DJ, and record producer. He is one of the most successful electronic dance music (EDM) artists from the Czech Republic. Rytmus has gained significant popularity not only in his home country but also internationally, particularly in Europe. His music often blends elements of house, trance, and progressive house, creating a unique sound that has resonated with a wide audience.

Rytmus has released several albums and singles, many of which have topped the charts in the Czech Republic. He has also performed at numerous music festivals and events, both in the Czech Republic and abroad. His contributions to the EDM scene have earned him recognition and respect within the music industry.
